```{r}
# load data
datapath <- 'data/'
DataFiles <- list.files(path = datapath, pattern = "*.csv", full.names = TRUE)

df_raw_all <- data.frame()

for (k in 1:length(DataFiles)) {
  df_temp <- read_csv(
    DataFiles[k],
    col_types = cols(
      rt = col_double(),
      response = col_character(),
      correct_response = col_character(),
      correct = col_logical(),
      block_failed = col_logical(),
      blocks_failed_total = col_double(),
      .default = col_guess()
    ),
    na = c("", "NA", "null", "NaN")
  )
  
  # Extract subject ID from filename
  subj_id <- str_match(basename(DataFiles[k]), "Han_curvRep2D_(\\d+)_")[, 2]
  df_temp$subj_id <- subj_id
  
  df_raw_all <- bind_rows(df_raw_all, df_temp)
}

df_raw_all <- df_raw_all %>% 
  select(subj_id, age, sex, rt, stimulus, response, block, block_index, trial_in_block, global_trial_index, trial_kind, pattern, feature_ids, features_triplet, stim_left, stim_middle, stim_right, is_practice, is_catch, correct_response, correct, chosen_index, chosen_stimulus, chosen_N, chosen_range, chosen_curv, chosen_seed)

```

```{r}
# catch trial accuracy for main trials
# main_catch <- df_raw_all %>%

# 
# main_catch %>%

#   summarise(
#     n_catch = n(),

#     accuracy = mean(correct == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE))

# each participant must get 75% catch trial accuracy min in each block to pass that block
block_catch_summary <- df_raw_all %>%
  filter(trial_kind == "catch") %>%
  group_by(subj_id, block_index) %>%
  summarise(
    n_catch = n(),
    n_correct = sum(correct == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    acc = n_correct / n_catch,
    blockUse = if_else(acc >= 0.75, 1, 0),  # 1 if acc >= 75%, else 0
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Count failed blocks per participant and assign subUse flag
subject_quality <- block_catch_summary %>%
  group_by(subj_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_failed_blocks = sum(blockUse == 0),  # Count blocks where blockUse = 0
    subUse = if_else(n_failed_blocks > 3, 0, 1),  # Flag: 0 if >3 failed, else 1
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# View results
subject_quality
subject_quality %>%
  count(subUse)

# Add subUse flag to original data frame
df_raw_all <- df_raw_all %>%
  left_join(subject_quality %>% select(subj_id, subUse), 
            by = "subj_id") %>%
  left_join(block_catch_summary %>% select(subj_id, block_index, blockUse),
            by = c("subj_id", "block_index"))
```

```{r}
# each row = one item in the triad. 
df_items <- df_trials %>%
  group_by(subj_id) %>%
  mutate(triad_id = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    subj_id, triad_id, chosen_index,
    stim_left, stim_middle, stim_right
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(stim_left, stim_middle, stim_right),
    names_to = "position",
    values_to = "stim_path"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pos_index = case_when(
      position == "stim_left"   ~ 0L,
      position == "stim_middle" ~ 1L,
      position == "stim_right"  ~ 2L
    ),
    choice = as.integer(pos_index == chosen_index),
    is_chosen = pos_index == chosen_index,
    nv   = as.integer(str_match(stim_path, "_N(\\d+)_curv")[,2]),
    rng  = as.integer(str_match(stim_path, "circle_rng(\\d+)_N")[,2]),
    sm_s = as.numeric(str_match(stim_path, "curv([0-9.]+)_seed")[,2]),
    sm = case_when(
      sm_s == 0.0 ~ 0,
      sm_s == 1.0 ~ 1,
      sm_s == 2.0 ~ 2,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_  # Handle unexpected values
    )
  )

head(df_items)
```

```{r}
# Step 1: Prep data and extract chosen-non_chosen pairs
stim_lookup <- df_items %>%
  select(sm, nv, rng) %>%
  distinct(sm, nv, rng) %>%
  arrange(sm, nv, rng) %>%
  mutate(stim_id = row_number())

stopifnot(nrow(stim_lookup) == 27)

triad_long <- df_items %>%
  select(subj_id, triad_id, pos_index, is_chosen, sm, nv, rng) %>%
  left_join(stim_lookup, by = c("sm", "nv", "rng")) %>%
  rename(stim_id = stim_id)

pairs_chosen_nc <- triad_long %>%
  group_by(subj_id, triad_id) %>%
  filter(n() == 3) %>%  # Sanity: exactly 3 stimuli/triad
  mutate(chosen_flag = is_chosen == 1) %>%
  summarise(
    chosen_id = stim_id[chosen_flag],
    non_ids = list(stim_id[!chosen_flag]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  unnest_longer(non_ids, values_to = "non_id") %>%
  mutate(
    low  = pmin(chosen_id, non_id),   # Unordered pair for aggregation
    high = pmax(chosen_id, non_id)
  )
# Output: One row per subj-triple-chosen_non pair (2 per triplet).

```

```{r}
# Step 2: Compute per-subject D
pairs_id <- df_items %>%
  select(subj_id, triad_id, pos_index, is_chosen, sm, nv, rng) %>%
  inner_join(., ., by = c("subj_id", "triad_id"), suffix = c("_i", "_j")) %>%
  filter(pos_index_i < pos_index_j) %>%
  left_join(stim_lookup, by = c("sm_i" = "sm", "nv_i" = "nv", "rng_i" = "rng")) %>%
  rename(stim_id_i = stim_id) %>%
  left_join(stim_lookup, by = c("sm_j" = "sm", "nv_j" = "nv", "rng_j" = "rng")) %>%
  rename(stim_id_j = stim_id) %>%
  mutate(
    low  = pmin(stim_id_i, stim_id_j),
    high = pmax(stim_id_i, stim_id_j)
  )

D_subj <- pairs_id %>%
  # Mark chosen-nonchosen relations (analogous to co_group for similarity)
  mutate(chosen_nc = (is_chosen_i == 1 & is_chosen_j == 0) | 
                    (is_chosen_j == 1 & is_chosen_i == 0)) %>%
  group_by(subj_id, low, high) %>%
  summarise(
    n_appear    = n(),           # Total appearances (denominator)
    n_chosen_nc = sum(chosen_nc), # # chosen-nonchosen (numerator, analog n_win)
    D           = n_chosen_nc / n_appear,  # P(chosen-non | co-occur)
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(D))


```

```{r}
# -------------------------
# K-means clustering of participants
# -------------------------

# Compute participant-specific RDMs
n_items <- 27

participant_rdms <- D_subj %>%
  group_by(subj_id) %>%
  summarise(
    RDM = list({
      # Initialize dissimilarity matrix (matches your D_mat style)
      D_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_items, ncol = n_items)
      rownames(D_mat) <- colnames(D_mat) <- as.character(1:n_items)
      
      # Fill D matrix with subject-specific ratios
      for (k in seq_len(n())) {
        i <- low[k]
        j <- high[k]
        D_mat[i, j] <- D[k]  # <-- D from D_subj (~2 for observed)
        D_mat[j, i] <- D[k]
      }
      diag(D_mat) <- 0
      D_mat  
    }),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# We only use the upper triangle (off-diagonal) to avoid redundancy
get_upper_vec <- function(mat) mat[upper.tri(mat)]
participant_rdms_vec <- participant_rdms %>%
  mutate(RDM_vec = map(RDM, get_upper_vec))

subj_ids <- participant_rdms$subj_id
n_subj <- length(subj_ids)
```

```{r}
# -------------------------
# 1. Prepare data & distances
# -------------------------
complete_pairs <- do.call(rbind, participant_rdms_vec$RDM_vec)
complete_pairs <- complete_pairs[, apply(complete_pairs, 2, function(x) all(!is.na(x)))]
# complete_pairs <- do.call(rbind, lapply(participant_rdms_vec$RDM_vec, 
#                                         function(v) replace(v, is.na(v), 0)))

pp_coords <- complete_pairs  
pp_dist <- dist(pp_coords)   

cat("Data:", nrow(pp_coords), "subjects x", ncol(pp_coords), "pairs\n")
```

```{r}
# -------------------------
# 4. Choose best k & fit final clustering
# -------------------------
k_opt <- 2
km_final <- kmeans(pp_coords, centers = k_opt, nstart = 100)

# Reorder cluster labels so largest = 1
cluster_sizes <- table(km_final$cluster)
cluster_order <- as.numeric(names(sort(cluster_sizes, decreasing = TRUE)))
new_labels <- match(km_final$cluster, cluster_order)

participant_clusters <- tibble(
  subj_id = subj_ids,
  cluster = factor(new_labels)
)

print(table(participant_clusters$cluster))
```

```{r}
# Preparing trial-level stimulus features
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggh4x)

df_items_rt <- df_trials %>%
  group_by(subj_id) %>%
  mutate(triad_id = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    subj_id, triad_id, trial_kind, rt, chosen_index,
    stim_left, stim_middle, stim_right
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(stim_left, stim_middle, stim_right),
    names_to = "position",
    values_to = "stim_path"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pos_index = case_when(
      position == "stim_left"   ~ 0L,
      position == "stim_middle" ~ 1L,
      position == "stim_right"  ~ 2L
    ),
    is_chosen = pos_index == chosen_index,
    nv = as.integer(str_match(stim_path, "_N(\\d+)_curv")[, 2]),
    rng = as.integer(str_match(stim_path, "circle_rng(\\d+)_N")[, 2]),
    sm_s = as.numeric(str_match(stim_path, "curv([0-9.]+)_seed")[, 2]),
    sm = case_when(
      sm_s == 0.0 ~ 0,
      sm_s == 1.0 ~ 1,
      sm_s == 2.0 ~ 2,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# Identifying choice basis for 1/1/1 and 2/2/1 trials

# for 1/1/1 trials: the feature shared by the two non-chosen stimuli 
# = the feature on which the chosen stimulus is the odd one out 
# = the one that the participant 'uses' to make that decision
rt_111 <- df_items_rt %>%
  filter(trial_kind == "exp_111") %>%
  group_by(subj_id, triad_id) %>%
  summarise(
    rt = first(rt),
    same_sm  = n_distinct(sm[!is_chosen]) == 1,
    same_nv  = n_distinct(nv[!is_chosen]) == 1,
    same_rng = n_distinct(rng[!is_chosen]) == 1,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    n_shared = same_sm + same_nv + same_rng,
    choice_basis = case_when(
      same_sm  & !same_nv & !same_rng ~ "Smoothness",
      same_nv  & !same_sm & !same_rng ~ "Vertices",
      same_rng & !same_sm & !same_nv ~ "Range",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    choice_basis = factor(
      choice_basis,
      levels = c("Smoothness", "Vertices", "Range")
    )
  )

# for 2/2/1 triplets: identify whether the chosen stimulus is an endpoint (unique on one feature) or a bridge (not unique on any feature).
# does chosen item have a feature value that occurs only once in the triplet?
# yes --> that feature is the choice_basis
# no --> it is the 'non-different' item / 'bridge' item and  exclude that trial
# if an item is uniquely different in number of vertices, then choice_basis = Vertices, etc.

rt_221_all <- df_items_rt %>%
  filter(trial_kind == "exp_221") %>%
  group_by(subj_id, triad_id) %>%
  summarise(
    rt = first(rt),
    basis_sm = (
      n_distinct(sm) == 2 &
        sum(sm == first(sm[is_chosen])) == 1
    ),
    basis_nv = (
      n_distinct(nv) == 2 &
        sum(nv == first(nv[is_chosen])) == 1
    ),
    basis_rng = (
      n_distinct(rng) == 2 &
        sum(rng == first(rng[is_chosen])) == 1
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    n_basis = basis_sm + basis_nv + basis_rng,
    choice_role = case_when(
      n_basis == 1 ~ "Endpoint",
      n_basis == 0 ~ "Bridge",
      TRUE ~ "Check"
    ),
    choice_basis = case_when(
      basis_sm & !basis_nv & !basis_rng ~ "Smoothness",
      basis_nv & !basis_sm & !basis_rng ~ "Vertices",
      basis_rng & !basis_sm & !basis_nv ~ "Range",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    choice_basis = factor(
      choice_basis,
      levels = c("Smoothness", "Vertices", "Range")
    )
  )

# excluded bridge choices count
rt_221_exclusion_counts <- rt_221_all %>%
  count(choice_role, name = "n_trials")

# exclude bridge-choice trials in RT analysis, use only endpoint-choice trials
rt_221 <- rt_221_all %>%
  filter(choice_role == "Endpoint", !is.na(choice_basis))
```

```{r}
# Combine trial types and attach participant clusters
rt_combined <- bind_rows(
  rt_111 %>%
    filter(!is.na(choice_basis)) %>%
    transmute(
      subj_id = as.character(subj_id),
      triad_id, rt,
      choice_basis = as.character(choice_basis),
      trial_type = "1/1/1"
    ),
  rt_221 %>%
    filter(!is.na(choice_basis)) %>%
    transmute(
      subj_id = as.character(subj_id),
      triad_id, rt,
      choice_basis = as.character(choice_basis),
      trial_type = "2/2/1"
    )
) %>%
  left_join(
    participant_clusters %>%
      mutate(subj_id = as.character(subj_id)),
    by = "subj_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    choice_basis = factor(
      choice_basis,
      levels = c("Smoothness", "Vertices", "Range")
    ),
    cluster = factor(
      cluster,
      levels = c(1, 2),
      labels = c("NV-Rng-dominant", "Smoothness-dominant")
    )
  )

# counts for checking the contributions of each trial type
rt_trial_counts <- rt_combined %>%
  group_by(cluster, choice_basis, trial_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n_participants = n_distinct(subj_id),
    n_trials = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
# # cluster × choice_basis interaction (2x3)
# Mixed-effects model and statistical comparisons
# log(RT) = Cluster x Choice Basis + (1 + Choice Basis | Participant)

# Does the relationship between choice basis and RT depend on the participant's cluster?
# possibility 1) yes. If cluster membership reflects which feature is especially salient to that person, then decisions based on that same feature might be easier/faster. so for the NV dominant cluster, vertices-based choices could be faster, etc.
# possibility 2) no. the RT differences observed are just driven by features. maybe some physical stimulus differences are simply to detect quickly, lije number of vertices. 

# account for trial type

rt_interaction_data <- rt_combined %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(rt), rt > 0,
    !is.na(cluster), !is.na(choice_basis),
    !is.na(trial_type)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cluster = factor(cluster,
      levels = c("NV-Rng-dominant", "Smoothness-dominant")
    ),
    choice_basis = factor(choice_basis,
      levels = c("Smoothness", "Vertices", "Range")
    ),
    trial_type = factor(trial_type,
      levels = c("1/1/1", "2/2/1")
    )
  )

# Full model: test whether choice-basis RT differences depend on cluster
rt_interaction_model <- lmer(
  log(rt) ~ cluster * choice_basis + trial_type + (1 + choice_basis | subj_id),
  data = rt_interaction_data,
  REML = FALSE,
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
)

# no interaction
rt_additive_model <- lmer(
  log(rt) ~ cluster + choice_basis + trial_type + (1 + choice_basis | subj_id),
  data = rt_interaction_data,
  REML = FALSE,
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
)

# Likelihood-ratio test of the cluster × choice_basis interaction
rt_model_comparison <- anova(
  rt_additive_model, rt_interaction_model, test = "Chisq"
)

# Holm-corrected comparisons within each cluster
emm_by_cluster <- emmeans(
  rt_interaction_model, ~ choice_basis | cluster
)

pairwise_results <- as.data.frame(
  pairs(emm_by_cluster, adjust = "holm")
) %>%
  separate(
    contrast,
    into = c("group1", "group2"),
    sep = " - ",
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    stars = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
  )
    
rt_model_comparison
summary(rt_interaction_model)
pairwise_results
```
```{r}
# Prepare participant medians and significance brackets

# One median RT per participant x choice basis, pooling both trial types
rt_participant_medians <- rt_interaction_data %>%
  group_by(subj_id, cluster, choice_basis) %>%
  summarise(
    median_rt = median(rt, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

rt_group_medians <- rt_participant_medians %>%
  group_by(cluster, choice_basis) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_of_medians = mean(median_rt),
    median_of_medians = median(median_rt),
    n_participants = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

sig_brackets_median <- pairwise_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(p.value), p.value < 0.05)

panel_heights_median <- rt_participant_medians %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    panel_max = max(median_rt, na.rm = TRUE),
    panel_min = min(median_rt, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    step = pmax(
      0.12 * (panel_max - panel_min),
      0.07 * panel_max
    )
  )

sig_brackets_median <- sig_brackets_median %>%
  left_join(panel_heights_median, by = "cluster") %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  mutate(
    y.position = panel_max + row_number() * step
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

feature_cols <- c(
  "Smoothness" = "#F8766D",
  "Vertices" = "#00BA38",
  "Range" = "#619CFF"
)

cluster_strip <- ggh4x::strip_themed(
  background_x = ggh4x::elem_list_rect(
    fill = c("#E8F7EC", "#FDE8E6"),
    colour = c("black", "black"),
    linewidth = c(0.6, 0.6)
  ),
  text_x = ggh4x::elem_list_text(
    colour = c("#00BA38", "#F8766D"),
    face = c("bold", "bold"),
    size = c(14, 14)
  )
)
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
print(p_median)

# important: violin plots show participant-level median RTs, but the significance brackets come from the trial-level mixed-effects model fitted to log(RT)
```

```{r}
# Prepare block-level choice data

# Attach block number to the combined choice-basis data

trial_block_lookup <- df_trials %>%
  group_by(subj_id) %>%
  mutate(triad_id = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    subj_id = as.character(subj_id),
    triad_id,
    block = as.integer(str_remove(block, "block_"))
  )

choice_time <- rt_combined %>%
  mutate(subj_id = as.character(subj_id)) %>%
  left_join(
    trial_block_lookup,
    by = c("subj_id", "triad_id")
  )


# Choice-basis proportions for each participant in each block

choice_by_block <- choice_time %>%
  count(
    subj_id,
    cluster,
    block,
    choice_basis,
    name = "n_choices"
  ) %>%
  group_by(subj_id, cluster, block) %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    choice_basis = c("Smoothness", "Vertices", "Range"),
    fill = list(n_choices = 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    n_usable = sum(n_choices),
    proportion = n_choices / n_usable
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    choice_basis = factor(
      choice_basis,
      levels = c("Smoothness", "Vertices", "Range")
    )
  )
choice_by_block
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
# Mean choice-basis proportion trajectories across blocks, with 95% CI

choice_block_cluster_summary <- choice_by_block %>%
  group_by(cluster, block, choice_basis) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_proportion = mean(proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_proportion = sd(proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = sum(!is.na(proportion)),
    se = sd_proportion / sqrt(n),
    ci_lower = mean_proportion - 1.96 * se,
    ci_upper = mean_proportion + 1.96 * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ci_lower = pmax(0, ci_lower),
    ci_upper = pmin(1, ci_upper)
  )

# Final choice-basis trajectory plot

p_choice_blocks <- ggplot(
  choice_block_cluster_summary,
  aes(
    x = block,
    y = mean_proportion,
    group = choice_basis,
    color = choice_basis,
    fill = choice_basis
  )
) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper),
    alpha = 0.12,
    color = NA
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  ggh4x::facet_wrap2(
    ~ cluster,
    strip = cluster_strip
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = feature_cols) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = feature_cols) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:9) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 0.82),
    breaks = seq(0, 0.8, 0.1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Block",
    y = "Mean proportion of choices",
    color = "Choice basis",
    fill = "Choice basis",
    title = "Choice-basis patterns across blocks by cluster"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
      color = "grey90",
      linewidth = 0.3
    )
  )

print(p_choice_blocks)
```

# Sensitivity Analysis
```{r}
# Prepare sensitivity datasets

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)
library(ggh4x)

# Reuse choice-basis classifications from the RT analysis.
# Bridge choices are included in the sensitivity analysis. they're coded as 0 for feature selection, so when participant selects a bridge in 2/2/1 trial, the relevant feature is coded as not chosen (0).

sensitivity_choice_basis <- bind_rows(
  rt_111 %>%
    transmute(
      subj_id = as.character(subj_id),
      triad_id,
      trial_type = "1/1/1",
      choice_basis = as.character(choice_basis)
    ),
  rt_221_all %>%
    transmute(
      subj_id = as.character(subj_id),
      triad_id,
      trial_type = "2/2/1",
      choice_basis = as.character(choice_basis)
    )
) %>%
  mutate(
    trial_type = factor(
      trial_type, levels = c("1/1/1", "2/2/1")
    )
  )

stopifnot(
  !anyDuplicated(
    sensitivity_choice_basis[c("subj_id", "triad_id")]
  )
)

# Participant cluster labels
sensitivity_cluster_lookup <- participant_clusters %>%
  transmute(
    subj_id = as.character(subj_id),
    cluster = factor(
      cluster,
      levels = c(1, 2),
      labels = c("NV-Rng-dominant", "Smoothness-dominant")
    )
  )

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(sensitivity_cluster_lookup$subj_id))

# Map vertex counts and ranges to categorical levels 0, 1, 2.
# Smoothness is already coded 0, 1, 2 in df_items_rt.

nv_values <- sort(unique(na.omit(df_items_rt$nv)))
range_values <- sort(unique(na.omit(df_items_rt$rng)))

stopifnot(
  length(nv_values) == 3,
  length(range_values) == 3
)

# Identify which levels appeared in each trial

sensitivity_trial_levels <- df_items_rt %>%
  mutate(
    subj_id = as.character(subj_id),
    nv_level = match(nv, nv_values) - 1L,
    range_level = match(rng, range_values) - 1L
  ) %>%
  group_by(subj_id, triad_id, trial_kind) %>%
  summarise(
    n_sm_levels = n_distinct(sm),
    sm_min = min(sm),
    sm_max = max(sm),

    n_nv_levels = n_distinct(nv_level),
    nv_min = min(nv_level),
    nv_max = max(nv_level),

    n_range_levels = n_distinct(range_level),
    range_min = min(range_level),
    range_max = max(range_level),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sm_level_category = case_when(
      n_sm_levels == 1 ~ "Constant",
      n_sm_levels == 2 & sm_min == 0 & sm_max == 1 ~ "0-1",
      n_sm_levels == 2 & sm_min == 1 & sm_max == 2 ~ "1-2",
      n_sm_levels == 2 & sm_min == 0 & sm_max == 2 ~ "0-2",
      n_sm_levels == 3 ~ "Three levels",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    nv_level_category = case_when(
      n_nv_levels == 1 ~ "Constant",
      n_nv_levels == 2 & nv_min == 0 & nv_max == 1 ~ "0-1",
      n_nv_levels == 2 & nv_min == 1 & nv_max == 2 ~ "1-2",
      n_nv_levels == 2 & nv_min == 0 & nv_max == 2 ~ "0-2",
      n_nv_levels == 3 ~ "Three levels",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    range_level_category = case_when(
      n_range_levels == 1 ~ "Constant",
      n_range_levels == 2 & range_min == 0 & range_max == 1 ~ "0-1",
      n_range_levels == 2 & range_min == 1 & range_max == 2 ~ "1-2",
      n_range_levels == 2 & range_min == 0 & range_max == 2 ~ "0-2",
      n_range_levels == 3 ~ "Three levels",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# Combine level categories, choices, and cluster labels

sensitivity_trials <- sensitivity_trial_levels %>%
  left_join(
    sensitivity_choice_basis,
    by = c("subj_id", "triad_id")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    sensitivity_cluster_lookup,
    by = "subj_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sm_chosen = as.integer(
      !is.na(choice_basis) & choice_basis == "Smoothness"
    ),
    nv_chosen = as.integer(
      !is.na(choice_basis) & choice_basis == "Vertices"
    ),
    range_chosen = as.integer(
      !is.na(choice_basis) & choice_basis == "Range"
    )
  )

# Retain trials where the relevant feature varies
# between exactly two categorical levels.

level_order <- c("0-1", "1-2", "0-2")

sm_sensitivity_data <- sensitivity_trials %>%
  filter(sm_level_category %in% level_order) %>%
  mutate(
    sm_level_category = factor(
      sm_level_category, levels = level_order
    )
  )

nv_sensitivity_data <- sensitivity_trials %>%
  filter(nv_level_category %in% level_order) %>%
  mutate(
    nv_level_category = factor(
      nv_level_category, levels = level_order
    )
  )

range_sensitivity_data <- sensitivity_trials %>%
  filter(range_level_category %in% level_order) %>%
  mutate(
    range_level_category = factor(
      range_level_category, levels = level_order
    )
  )

# Model datasets
sm_model_data <- sm_sensitivity_data
nv_model_data <- nv_sensitivity_data
range_model_data <- range_sensitivity_data

# Verify that cluster and trial type are available for modeling
stopifnot(
  !anyNA(sm_model_data$cluster),
  !anyNA(sm_model_data$trial_type),
  !anyNA(nv_model_data$cluster),
  !anyNA(nv_model_data$trial_type),
  !anyNA(range_model_data$cluster),
  !anyNA(range_model_data$trial_type)
)

# Participant-level proportions for the three plots
sm_sensitivity_cluster <- sm_model_data %>%
  group_by(subj_id, cluster, sm_level_category) %>%
  summarise(
    n_presented = n(),
    n_sm_chosen = sum(sm_chosen),
    proportion = n_sm_chosen / n_presented,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

nv_sensitivity_cluster <- nv_model_data %>%
  group_by(subj_id, cluster, nv_level_category) %>%
  summarise(
    n_presented = n(),
    n_nv_chosen = sum(nv_chosen),
    proportion = n_nv_chosen / n_presented,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

range_sensitivity_cluster <- range_model_data %>%
  group_by(subj_id, cluster, range_level_category) %>%
  summarise(
    n_presented = n(),
    n_range_chosen = sum(range_chosen),
    proportion = n_range_chosen / n_presented,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
# Fit the three sensitivity models
# Binomial GLMs, controlling for trial (type 1/1/1 or 2/2/1)
# logit(P(feature chosen)) = Cluster x Level Comparison + Trial Type + (1 | Participant)

# SMOOTHNESS
sm_sensitivity_model <- glmer(
  sm_chosen ~ cluster * sm_level_category +
    trial_type + (1 | subj_id),
  data = sm_model_data,
  family = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
)

# VERTICES
nv_sensitivity_model <- glmer(
  nv_chosen ~ cluster * nv_level_category +
    trial_type + (1 | subj_id),
  data = nv_model_data,
  family = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
)

# RANGE
range_sensitivity_model <- glmer(
  range_chosen ~ cluster * range_level_category +
    trial_type + (1 | subj_id),
  data = range_model_data,
  family = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
)

# Estimated marginal means within each cluster
sm_emm <- emmeans(
  sm_sensitivity_model, ~ sm_level_category | cluster
)

nv_emm <- emmeans(
  nv_sensitivity_model, ~ nv_level_category | cluster
)

range_emm <- emmeans(
  range_sensitivity_model, ~ range_level_category | cluster
)
```

```{r}
# Prepare Holm-corrected comparisons and significance brackets

prepare_sensitivity_brackets <- function(emm) {

  comparisons <- list(
    "0-1 vs 1-2" = c(1, -1, 0),
    "1-2 vs 0-2" = c(0, 1, -1),
    "0-1 vs 0-2" = c(1, 0, -1)
  )

  positions <- tibble(
    contrast = names(comparisons),
    xmin = c(1, 2, 1),
    xmax = c(2, 3, 3),
    y.position = c(1.05, 1.14, 1.23)
  )

  pairwise <- as.data.frame(
    contrast(
      emm,
      method = comparisons,
      adjust = "holm"
    )
  ) %>%
    left_join(positions, by = "contrast") %>%
    mutate(
      stars = case_when(
        !is.na(p.value) & p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
        !is.na(p.value) & p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",
        !is.na(p.value) & p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ "ns"
      )
    )

  stopifnot(
    !anyNA(pairwise$xmin),
    !anyNA(pairwise$xmax),
    !anyNA(pairwise$y.position)
  )

  significant <- pairwise %>%
    filter(!is.na(p.value), p.value < 0.05)

  # Horizontal brackets and vertical tips
  lines <- bind_rows(
    significant %>%
      transmute(
        cluster,
        x = xmin, xend = xmax,
        y = y.position, yend = y.position
      ),

    significant %>%
      transmute(
        cluster,
        x = xmin, xend = xmin,
        y = y.position - 0.02, yend = y.position
      ),

    significant %>%
      transmute(
        cluster,
        x = xmax, xend = xmax,
        y = y.position - 0.02, yend = y.position
      )
  )

  # Significance stars
  labels <- significant %>%
    transmute(
      cluster,
      x = (xmin + xmax) / 2,
      y = y.position + 0.035,
      stars
    )

  list(
    pairwise = pairwise,
    significant = significant,
    lines = lines,
    labels = labels
  )
}

# Apply to each feature
sm_brackets <- prepare_sensitivity_brackets(sm_emm)
nv_brackets <- prepare_sensitivity_brackets(nv_emm)
range_brackets <- prepare_sensitivity_brackets(range_emm)

# Retain named statistical results
sm_pairwise <- sm_brackets$pairwise
nv_pairwise <- nv_brackets$pairwise
range_pairwise <- range_brackets$pairwise

sm_sig_brackets <- sm_brackets$significant
nv_sig_brackets <- nv_brackets$significant
range_sig_brackets <- range_brackets$significant

# Brackets and labels for plotting
sm_lines <- sm_brackets$lines
nv_lines <- nv_brackets$lines
range_lines <- range_brackets$lines

sm_labels <- sm_brackets$labels
nv_labels <- nv_brackets$labels
range_labels <- range_brackets$labels

sm_pairwise
nv_pairwise
range_pairwise
```

```{r}
# Shared plotting function for Smoothness, Vertices, and Range

plot_sensitivity <- function(
    subject_data,
    level_column,
    feature,
    bracket_lines,
    bracket_labels) {

  ggplot(
    subject_data,
    aes(
      x = .data[[level_column]],
      y = proportion
    )
  ) +

    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.5,
      outlier.shape = NA,
      fill = "grey85"
    ) +

    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.08,
      height = 0,
      size = 2,
      alpha = 0.5
    ) +

    # White diamond = mean of participant proportions
    stat_summary(
      fun = mean,
      geom = "point",
      shape = 23,
      size = 4,
      fill = "white",
      color = "black"
    ) +

    # Significance brackets
    geom_segment(
      data = bracket_lines,
      aes(
        x = x, xend = xend,
        y = y, yend = yend
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = 0.6
    ) +

    # Significance stars
    geom_text(
      data = bracket_labels,
      aes(
        x = x,
        y = y,
        label = stars
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 5
    ) +

    ggh4x::facet_wrap2(
      ~ cluster,
      strip = cluster_strip
    ) +

    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)
    ) +

    coord_cartesian(
      ylim = c(0, 1.33)
    ) +

    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +

    labs(
      x = paste(feature, "level comparison"),
      y = paste0(
        "Proportion of ",
        tolower(feature),
        "-based choices"
      ),
      title = paste(
        feature,
        "sensitivity by participant cluster"
      )
    )
}
```
